description: This file is a shell script that sources another shell library and includes functions for interacting with CVS and Git repositories, such as checking out branches, comparing files and directories, and setting up test repositories. It appears to be part of a test suite for CVS and Git integration.

methods.name: setup_cvs_test_repository
methods.description: Sets up a CVS test repository by copying a predefined CVSROOT into the current working directory.

methods.name: test_cvs_co
methods.description: Checks out a CVS module branch, handling 'main' branch or specific branch names.

methods.name: test_git_co
methods.description: Checks out a specific branch in the Git repository.

methods.name: test_cmp_branch_file
methods.description: Compares a specific file between CVS and Git checked-out branches.

methods.name: test_cmp_branch_tree
methods.description: Checks out a branch from CVS and Git, compares directory listings, and ensures all files and directories match between the two repositories.
